6277-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6277-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

2150-3991-6495.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
2150-3991-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2921-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4377-4863-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Revolutionist.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Revolutionist from exile to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1496-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
1496-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

618-7616.description:
Activate the mutated Boneyard Lurker and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

240-1753-2034-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5078-5741.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

341-2034-4871-6005-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Umori.
Repeat.

2692-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

5963-7009-7012.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5963-7009-7012.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Marvin.
Repeat each turn.

147-3440-5231.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-1563-2457-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2-4772-5637.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2099-2558-3490-5231-6701.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2099-2558-3490-5231-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

1308-2043-5231-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1061-6653-6656.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1061-6653-6656.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Liliana's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Fauna Shaman by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a creature card, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

3918-4851-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1020-1117-4908-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

969-1563-2351-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
969-1563-2351-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

5256-5263-6243.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

11-2103-3942-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-2103-3942-6276.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Capture of Jingzhou, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-2103-3942-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Karador this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

950-1486-1753-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
950-1486-1753-5929.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.
950-1486-1753-5929.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1309-1987-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
1309-1987-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

5256-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
5256-5972-5973.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous Neonate

4624-5731.description:
Cast Revenge by paying its mana cost, doubling your life total.
If Sorin is on the battlefield as Sorin of House Markov, move to your postcombat main phase. Sorin of House Markov's second ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Sorin, Ravenous Neonate.
Activate Sorin, Ravenous Neonate's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, dealing damage to target opponent equal to the life you gained this turn.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

413-1270-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
413-1270-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When Lazotep Convert enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When Lazotep Convert enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

535-2438-3451-4766.notablePrerequisites: You have an Elf creature card in your graveyard with mana value four or greater.
535-2438-3451-4766.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Elderfang Ritualist.
When Elderfang Ritualist dies, it, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Elderfang Ritualist trigger, returning an Elf creature card with mana value four or greater from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the Elf with mana value four or greater from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return a creature card with mana value two or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Elderfang Ritualist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Elderfang Ritualist from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 6, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

283-890-2722-5089.notablePrerequisites: Magewright's Stone and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
283-890-2722-5089.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Magewright's Stone to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Illusionist's Bracers' equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Magewright's Stone.
Activate Magewright's Stone by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Magewright's Stone abillity, targeting Palladium Myr.
Resolve both Magewright's Stone abilities, untapping Magewright's Stone and Palladium Myr.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.

1409-2732-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Prowling Geistcatcher.
You control at least three other nontoken creatures.
1409-2732-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three other nontoken creatures, adding {2}{U}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers three times, exiling the sacrificed creatures from your graveyard.
Activate Prowling Geistcatcher by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning all creature cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Prowling Geistcatcher enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing it and Prowling Geistcatcher.
Repeat.

512-1322-2067-4289.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is at least fifteen.
512-1322-2067-4289.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat step 2 until you have at least fifteen tapped creatures.
Activate Halo Fountain's third ability by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}, tapping it and untapping fifteen tapped creatures you control, causing you to win the game.
